newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures close higher on weaker yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures close higher on weaker yen.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher across the board on Tuesday, as the yen's fall against the dollar triggered buying from local investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 20 yen to 120 yen per tonne higher, with the benchmark May 1998 contract closing 110 yen up at 13,910 yen. The day's estimated trade volume was 26,948 lots.
As the Chicago corn market was closed on Monday due to the Memorial Day holiday, the movement of the yen/dollar rate was a key factor behind the buying orders from individual investors, traders said.
"Investors were basically sidelined today, waiting for direction from the CBOT market tonight," a brokerage house trader said.
